description: Turns a quote (from get_quote) into an order, payable for 24 hours. Same account as the quote: its session Cookie header, or its agent key as Authorization: Bearer (order scope). Returns the order with payment.url: POST it without a credential for a 402 card challenge (MPP, method stripe, a Stripe Shared Payment Token), then again with Authorization: Payment. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry return the same order. The price includes any VAT. Nothing is charged by this tool.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key, the same on every retry of this order.

name: create_order
title: Order an offer
